summary: Create a formal Gradle plugin for the workflowcheck static analyzer tool. This would provide a more integrated and standardized way for Java developers to use workflowcheck in their Gradle builds.
userImpact: Developers can use workflowcheck more easily and formally within their Gradle-based Java projects without manual configuration.
proposedFix: Create a formal Gradle plugin for workflowcheck static analyzer
keyQuote: The workflowcheck static analyzer done in #2767 should have a more formal Gradle plugin
